stories.title: Reports of AI-related child sexual abuse material rise 8,400% in two years, data shows
stories.summary: Reports of AI-related child sexual abuse material increased by more than 8,400% in two years, according to research from the Edinburgh-based Childlight Global Child Safety Institute. The report said cases, including deepfakes created with ‘nudify’ apps, rose from about 4,700 in 2023 to more than 400,000 in 2025, prompting calls for governments to treat child sexual exploitation as a preventable public-health emergency.

stories.title: Hamas Releases Four Female Israeli Soldiers Under Gaza Cease-Fire Deal
stories.summary: Hamas released four female Israeli soldiers under the multiphase Gaza cease-fire agreement. They were the second group of hostages freed since the deal took effect, raising hopes that the arrangement could support a lasting end to the war.

stories.title: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
stories.summary: Major shipping companies remain wary of returning to Red Sea routes despite a Houthi pledge to stop targeting vessels. The world’s three largest container operators said instability in Gaza and broader regional tensions continue to pose a danger.
